name: veridian-service-desk
description: A source-grounded internal service desk assessment prototype.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,green "npm run dev --workspace=@veridian/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@veridian/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@veridian/api && npm run build --workspace=@veridian/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,green "npm run start --workspace=@veridian/api" "npm run start --workspace=@veridian/web"
scripts.db:bootstrap: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.check: npm run typecheck --workspace=@veridian/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@veridian/web && node --test reference-core/engine.test.mjs reference-core/auth.test.mjs && npm run build && npm run test:integration
